_comment: Which local tests run on GitHub Actions, and in which order they are turned on.
A test is enabled by editing this file in a reviewed commit; the workflow never discovers tests by itself.
throughBatch: entries whose batch is greater than this are planned but not run.  workflow_dispatch can override it.
Per platform a test is 'observe' (a build or test failure is reported as a warning and does not fail the job),
'required' (a failure fails the job) or 'excluded' (does not run; 'reason' says why).
A new batch starts as 'observe'; promote it to 'required' after it has been green on that platform for several runs.
kind: dotnet-test = dotnet test --project <target>; dotnet-run = dotnet run --project <target>; msbuild = dotnet msbuild <target> -t:Build.
'measuredSeconds' is the last measured duration of the entry (local until a CI run has recorded it); keep it current when promoting a batch.
